integrity: The equal-weight two-uniform CDF is explicitly treated as prior art. The claimed contribution is the arbitrary-weight formula, its strict weight extremum, and the exact two-test calibration consequence. Numerical checks corroborate but do not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two independent continuous uniform null p-values with deterministic normalized weights; no claim for dependence, discrete or conservative p-values, data-dependent weights, more than two inputs, or power.
title: Exact two-test calibration and weight extremum for independent harmonic-mean p-values
